_note: Adjudications for sweep batch 02 (2026-08-09 to 2026-08-20). Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

reviews.note: Sets 2027 as the revival year and puts the church judgment before it in sequence.
Adds heaven on earth for the church and an open promise that everything believed for manifests.
Also the clearest rapture statement in the batch; the 2027 window is framed as a question put to the listener.
Puts a four-month kick-off window on the Rosh Hashanah start, so it expires 11 Jan 2027.
Named person, named race, named date, and a claimed direct quotation from God. Among the cleanest scoreable claims in the corpus.
Byron half is a restatement; the new content is the too-big-to-rig claim about the midterms.
He uses a JP Morgan note as corroboration and back-dates his tractors vision to it.
Conditional in form: he asks whether the two-state call triggers it rather than asserting a link.
Adds the Biden-cancelled pipelines and the Venezuela motive to the oil word, dated back to 2025.
The horse syringe image, dated 27 April 2026.
He pre-emptively disowns this one as possibly flesh, and the number 25 has no stated unit. Left unsure.
Explicitly downgrades it: discussed, not decided. Recorded as multiple_paths so a non-event does not score as a miss.
Worst since 1929 is a much harder claim than his earlier shallow break; the two tellings disagree on magnitude.
Also carries the 2027 stimulus timeline; the Greenland strand is the new material.
Extends the window to Rosh Hashanah 2027, a full year rather than four months. Disagrees with -Z-oPJQyOeU@5911.
He puts September and post-election on the table as alternatives, which is a branch rather than the flat September call he made elsewhere.
Dated back to a January 2025 vision and hedged with a not-a-financial-advisor disclaimer.
Video-length housekeeping and a plug for tomorrow's stream.
Notable method claim: he says his son verifies the tech exists before he airs the word.
Ties current tech to his 2014 tribulation vision. Left unsure because the vision content is not restated here, only asserted to match.
Adds Brazil and its October election as a second front.
Pulls the socialist control window forward from 2030 to 2027-2028.
The spider image gives the mechanism: aimed at the second amendment, it binds the first.
Anchors the acceleration claim to a dated prior word of 23 September 2025.
Widens the frame to 2027-2030 while keeping 2028 as the worst year.
Doctrinal teaching on the remnant; no dated or observable claim.
Applies the clampdown to himself: he expects to lose the YouTube platform.
Devotional teaching, no claim.
A prayer over the primaries with no named outcome, so it cannot be scored on its own.
Places the Israeli vote in a run of pivotal elections and adds France 2027, Carney and Macron.
Gives the exact civil dates for the feast: evening of 11 September into the 12th and 13th.
Green-and-globe emblem fragment with a clip he cannot get to play; too thin to attach to any claim.
The self-set test: he says outright that if Byron loses the primary the word was off. Due 23 Aug 2026, before the Florida result recorded a week later.
Anointing with oil, with a conditional escape clause that makes any failure the listener's fault.
Links the brush harbor revival to a second plague closing church buildings.
He treats Russian fuel queues after the 10 August strikes as the fulfilment of the gas-lines word.
Isaiah 64 recited in prayer.
Adds that God will not share the glory, which reads as a check against a celebrity-led revival.
A sliver of time, with no referent given. Kept unsure.
Records that the September-versus-post-election question is the one his audience asks most.
Self-description plus an unusually direct admission that he has missed timing before.
The standing epistemic disclaimer. Worth keeping visible because it qualifies every dated claim in the corpus.
Unusual method note: he dates visions by the angle of sunlight on buildings, which is how November-December was derived.
The package offered again reads as a second vaccination push, but he does not say so directly.
Ukraine territorial control word dated 3 March 2026; no existing canonical claim covers it and one telling is not enough to seed one.
